source.author: verg
source.text: Scilicet is Superis labor est, ea cura quietos sollicitat.
source.text_original: Scilicet is Superis labor est, ea cura quietos / sollicitat.
source.text_english: So that is the gods’ labor; that concern disturbs their peace.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Causa autem tantorum scelerum illa est, quod putaverunt providentiam non esse super terram, nec Deum curare mortalia, juxta illud quod alibi legimus: Scilicet is superis labor est, ea cura quietos Sollicitat.
reuse.text_original: Causa autem tantorum scelerum illa est, quod putaverunt providentiam non esse super terram, nec Deum curare mortalia, juxta illud quod alibi legimus: Scilicet is superis labor est, ea cura quietos Sollicitat.
reuse.text_english: The cause of so great crimes is this: they thought that providence was not on the earth, and that God did not care for mortal affairs, according to what we read elsewhere: Surely this is toil for the gods above; this concern disturbs them in their peace.
